playstyle: Long-range powerhouse. Poke from outside the opponent's reach with his long legs (3, uf+4, b+3+4), break their guard with string mix-ups and charged knees, and win big when Garuda Force (GRF) powers him up in Heat. He is slow up close, so do not let the opponent get inside for free.

stances.name: Garuda Force
stances.entry: Heat activation, or a counter-hit d+4 throw
stances.note: A power-up install: GRF powers up specific moves and gives string extensions (Wavu).

stances.name: Rama Stance
stances.entry: Landing from GRF.1+2, df+3+4,GRF.3, GRF.4* and GRF.3*
stances.note: A landing stance only reachable through Garuda Force moves.

keyMoves: Ayutthaya: i13 long mid, -9 on block.
One of the longest pokes in the game (Wavu).
At range to poke and start strings.
A fast option, which he lacks elsewhere.
i15 punish string that crumples on hit (+52cs).
Surging Elbow: i14 mid, evades jabs, launches (+34a). -13 on block.
After lows that are -15 or worse.
Heavy Middle Kick: i18 mid, launches on counter hit (+58a).
A long CH launcher with good sidestep tracking.
At range when they step in.
Lashing Squall: i18 high, +6 on block, launches on hit (+47a).
To keep the turn at range.
A scary high: make them duck, then mid them.
Rumbling Thunder: i14 low, -15 on block; shifts to a throw and GRF on counter hit.
Low with a big CH reward.
Thundershock Kick: i16 homing high, Heat Engager.
To start Heat and catch steps.
Raging Knee: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
